title: Postoperative Pain in Children Aged From 3 to 5 Years Following Full Mouth Dental Rehabilitation Under General Anesthesia. A Cross-sectional Study. Rehabilitation Under General Anesthesia
brief_summary: the purpose of this study is monitoring Postoperative pain in Children Aged from 3 to 5 years following Full mouth Dental Rehabilitation under General Anesthesia
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Egyptian dental children undergoing full mouth dental rehabilitation under general anesthesia (3-5 years old )
* Children selected from pediatric dentistry and dental public health department Faculty of dentistry Cairo University
* Children with no developmental delay.
* Children with normal physical status.
* Parents who can be communicated well

Exclusion Criteria:

* Parents refusing participation in the study.
* Parents who cannot be communicated well
* Children with developmental abnormalities
study_population: All children attending the outpatients' clinic of pediatric Dentistry and Public Health Faculty of Dentistry Cairo University-Egypt in the period of three months. (With average 30 patients in week ).
